title: IZAKA-YA advertised a 1000% APR-equivalent switching campaign
description: IZAKA-YA announced a campaign for users transferring assets from other exchanges or wallets. The first step advertised total rewards equivalent to 1000% APR for a three-day lending period, combining the normal or campaign lending rate with an additional reward and subject to eligibility requirements and a reward cap.
notes: This event records an issuer-advertised promotional rate and its conditions. It is not evidence of verified realized customer returns, universal payout, platform solvency, or a change in active status.

title: IZAKA-YA announced the August 150 Festival
description: IZAKA-YA announced an August 11–24 campaign advertising 100% annualized lending on selected terms and an additional transfer bonus described as an effective 150% annualized rate for qualifying users.
notes: The 100% and 150% figures are preserved as issuer-advertised campaign formulas, not verified realized customer returns or evidence of platform solvency.
